Author: SunnysOfficial
Name: Venue Mapper
Description: A Dalamud plugin for discovering FFXIV venues with 2D/3D interactive markers, live events, and built-in owner tools. Your complete FFXIV venue guide.
TestingChangelog:
## v0.6.0.6 (Testing)

- Improved: Seasonal decoration with real snowflakes, snow drifts, bats, pumpkins and fireworks, Pride Month theme removed
- Improved: Event cards all the same size, now with the address
- Removed: Event pictures in the Events tab

## v0.6.0.5 (Testing)

- Added: Seasonal decoration in the window background
- Added: 12h or 24h, server or local time, relative times
- Added: Event pictures from Partake in the Events tab
- Added: Export and import your settings as a code or file
- Added: Changed house rules show again with the changes marked
- Added: Festival and feedback pages on the VenueMapper website

Earlier testing builds: clickable notifications, live preview for venues and festivals, interface size, smarter chat links
